name: DARA-ABR paper evaluation, v2 (extends v1)
frozen_before: any run of set 1 (ct1, ct2 additions, ct8) and set 2 (cth4 additions, ctd1, ctl); after the first five-seed batch (v1), whose results motivated this extension
note: All v1 rules stand. v2 adds two sets of training environments. Rules below decide what is claimed; changing them after results exist is reported as a deviation.

evaluation.score: J0 = sum over chunks of q(tier) - 1.075 * freeze_s - |q(tier_t) - q(tier_t-1)|, q = (1.00, 1.92, 2.61, 3.30, 4.00); uncapped, unclipped
evaluation.checkpoint: DARA-L, DARA and PPO variants: final policy. Pensieve and COREL: best validation checkpoint, as in their released code

statistics.session_level: Wilcoxon signed-rank on per-session J0 averaged over each method's seeds
statistics.seed_level: Welch t-test on per-seed mean J0

hierarchical.method: bootstrap, seeds resampled within each method, sessions resampled jointly

statistics.claim_rule: 'better' or 'worse' only if session-level q < alpha AND the bootstrap interval excludes 0; neither: 'no significant difference'; exactly one: 'inconclusive (tests disagree)'. Seed-level p is reported alongside, never used alone.

budget_rule_test.rule: DARA-L J0 within 5% of the J0 of the best hand-picked budget on the same environment

figure.rationale: The paper is about 5G mmWave. The figure shows mmWave networks only: the training generator with unseen chunk-size ladders, and real mmWave traces (Lumos5G). seen/x4 is the training condition, reported in Table I.

table.rationale: All tested conditions are reported in a table, including both Irish 5G sets (commercial mid-band 5G, not mmWave) as a stress test outside the training distribution.

caveats: Lumos5G is the dataset the network generator was calibrated on; it is real-trace evidence, not an independent network.
COREL receives the near-true throughput 0, 1, 3 and 6 s ahead (+/-16% noise), as in its released simulator, on every test network.

dropped_from_previous_design.reason: synthetic stress tests replaced by real traces (Lumos5G); still available in the notebook

set1.description: mmWave generator with four chunk-size ladders

set3.description: unseen networks for the ct4 models: the v1 generalisation test, unchanged (no new runs)

held_out_traces.rule: held-out traces are used only by the final 100 test sessions; training, BC data, DARA's diagnostic states and learning gate, and COREL/Pensieve validation use only the training traces
held_out_traces.not_held_out: cts1 (5 traces) and the mmWave generator (fresh sessions); their test results are in-distribution

sensitivity.where: ct1 only, the only set-1 environment with 0.15 <= M < 0.2 (M = 0.164)

families: Benjamini-Hochberg within each training environment, separately for registered comparisons (set 'against' lists) and any other comparison

claims.C1_diagnosis_predicts_failure: Over the set-1 reward settings (4 ladders x caps 0.1/0.25/0.5/1/no cap, plus caps 2 and 5 on ct4), M before training is positively rank-correlated with the trained shortfall (best single tier J0 - trained J0) / |best single tier J0|: Spearman rho > 0 with a 95% bootstrap interval (seeds resampled within each setting) excluding 0.
claims.C2_no_false_alarm: On ct1 (M = 0.164 < 0.2) DARA does not act in any seed, and DARA-L is not significantly worse than any hand-picked budget there.
claims.C3_budget_rule: In every environment where DARA acts in all seeds and at least 3 hand budgets were trained (ct2, ct4, ct8, cth4), DARA-L's J0 is within 5% of the best hand budget. Reported as passes k of n; no environment is dropped.
claims.C4_vs_fixed_budget: Per environment (all 7), DARA-L vs PPO-Lagrangian 0.5 s: verdict reported for each (better / worse / no significant difference / tests disagree).
claims.C5_baselines: Per environment, DARA-L vs COREL, Pensieve and RobustMPC: verdicts reported; no pass rule.
